title: Grounding Large Language Models as Generalizable Policies in Network Control
abstract: arXiv:2512.11839v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Designing generalizable control policies that operate reliably under changing conditions is essential for robust network services in modern digital infrastructure. Yet network control remains dominated by specialized policies built from handcrafted rules or deep learning models, which struggle to generalize under real-world dynamics. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising alternative because of their broad pretrained knowledge and emergent generalization abilities, but their practical adoption in network control is hindered by non-textual observations, constrained action spaces, complex optimization knowledge, and strict real-time requirements. Therefore, we introduce Trailblazer, a systematic framework that combines domain alignment to adapt LLMs for network control with adaptive policy collaboration to reduce inference overhead. translated_title: 将大型语言模型作为网络控制中的通用策略进行落地
translated_abstract: 设计在变化条件下可靠运行的通用控制策略，对于现代数字基础设施中稳健的网络服务至关重要。然而，网络控制仍主要由基于手工规则或深度学习模型构建的专用策略主导，这些策略在真实世界动态下难以泛化。大型语言模型（LLMs）因其广泛的预训练知识和涌现的泛化能力，提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但其在网络控制中的实际应用受到非文本观测、受限动作空间、复杂优化知识以及严格实时要求的阻碍。因此，我们引入了Trailblazer，这是一个系统化框架，结合领域对齐以将LLMs适配到网络控制，以及自适应策略协作以降低推理开销。在两个异构网络控制任务（自适应比特率流传输和集群管理）上的模拟表明，Trailblazer在性能上优于现有基线，同时将推理延迟降低多达42%，展示了其作为通用网络控制策略的潜力。
tldr: 本文提出Trailblazer框架，通过领域对齐和自适应策略协作，使大型语言模型能高效泛化于网络控制任务，并显著降低推理延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Trailblazer, a framework that adapts large language models to network control via domain alignment and adaptive policy collaboration, achieving superior performance and up to 42% lower inference latency.
